title: Set response metadata
summary: Django: Set response metadata. Inspect Cache-Control with curl -i.
introduction: A response object can store headers. GET /note/ has a no-store cache rule.

blocks.text: Install django~=5.2, run django-admin startproject school, then enter school. Replace school/urls.py with each example and run python manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000. These view examples need no database tables.

blocks.title: Set response metadata
blocks.code:
from django.http import HttpResponse, JsonResponse, HttpResponseNotAllowed
from django.shortcuts import redirect
from django.urls import path, reverse
import json
def note(request):
    response = HttpResponse("Practice note", content_type="text/plain")
    response["Cache-Control"] = "no-store"
    return response
urlpatterns = [
path("note/", note),
]

blocks.text: The header is set on the response object before the view returns it.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Set headers before returning the response.
